import numpy as np
from scirel.sampling import flux_surface_avg
r,z=np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0,1,5),np.linspace(-.2,.2,5))
p=np.column_stack([np.linspace(0,1,33),np.zeros(33)])
assert np.allclose(flux_surface_avg(r,z,np.ones_like(r),p),1)
